pack.name: PCI-DSS (Architecture / Segmentation)
pack.description: CDE segmentation and payment-data handling themes. Not PCI-DSS QSA attestation.

rules.title: Cardholder data environment (CDE) boundary documented
rules.description: Architecture must explicitly delineate the CDE and all connected systems — scope reduction requires documented segmentation evidence.
rules.remediationGuidance: Mark CDE-scoped services and datastores in governance.ComplianceTags; draw boundary in metadata.ChangeDescription.

frameworkMappings.theme: Req 1 — Install and maintain network security controls (CDE scope)

rules.title: Network segmentation between CDE and out-of-scope
rules.description: Segmentation controls (firewalls, NSGs, private link) must document deny-by-default rules between CDE and corporate zones.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe segmentation in governance.PolicyConstraints; align NSG and subnet posture with azureExtractor inventory.

rules.title: Inbound and outbound CDE traffic restricted
rules.description: Only documented, approved ports and protocols may traverse CDE boundaries — no blanket allow rules.
rules.remediationGuidance: Enumerate allowed flows on relationships[]; document firewall rule rationale in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Secure configurations for CDE components
rules.description: Systems in the CDE must reference hardened baselines with default credentials removed and unnecessary services disabled.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag CDE services with hardening baseline in services[].Tags; document CIS-style config in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: PAN storage prohibited outside CDE
rules.description: Primary account numbers must not be stored in out-of-scope datastores unless documented tokenization/vault pattern exists.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag PAN storage locations on datastores[].Tags; document tokenization in governance.PolicyConstraints.

frameworkMappings.theme: Req 3.1 — Keep PAN storage to a minimum

rules.title: PAN masking for display and logging
rules.description: Systems displaying or logging card data must document masking (show only last digits) with full PAN access restricted.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe masking rules in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Purpose for payment UI and logging services.

rules.title: PAN encryption at rest in CDE
rules.description: Stored PAN must document strong cryptography (AES-256, HSM, or P2PE) with key management separation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record encryption and key custody in governance.RequiredControls and datastores[].Tags.

rules.title: Cryptographic key management documented
rules.description: Key generation, distribution, storage, rotation, and destruction for PAN encryption must be explicit in architecture.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document Key Vault/HSM usage in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: TLS for PAN transmission over open networks
rules.description: Card data transmitted over public networks must document TLS 1.2+ and certificate management — no legacy SSL.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture TLS requirements in governance.PolicyConstraints; map payment API edges on relationships[].

rules.title: Anti-malware for CDE systems
rules.description: CDE servers and endpoints must document malware protection or compensating controls for unsupported platforms.
rules.remediationGuidance: List malware controls in governance.RequiredControls for CDE-tagged services[].Tags.

rules.title: Secure development for payment applications
rules.description: Custom payment code must reference secure SDLC, code review, and vulnerability remediation before CDE deployment.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document payment SDLC gates in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Need-to-know access to cardholder data
rules.description: CDE access must follow least privilege with documented role definitions — no broad admin access to PAN stores.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe CDE RBAC in governance.PolicyConstraints; align privileged roles with azureExtractor identity data.

frameworkMappings.theme: Req 7 — Restrict access by business need

rules.title: Unique IDs for CDE users and administrators
rules.description: Shared accounts are prohibited for CDE administrative access — each operator must have a unique identity.
rules.remediationGuidance: Prohibit shared-account tags on CDE services; document unique ID policy in governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: MFA for CDE administrative access
rules.description: All administrative access to the CDE must document multi-factor authentication — not password alone.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record MFA requirement in governance.RequiredControls and governance.ComplianceTags for CDE scope.

rules.title: Physical access themes for cloud CDE
rules.description: Cloud-hosted CDE must document provider physical security reliance and customer secure admin access paths.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note provider certification reliance in governance.ComplianceTags for selected Azure regions.

rules.title: Audit trail for CDE access and changes
rules.description: All access to cardholder data and security-impacting changes must log user, timestamp, and action to tamper-resistant storage.
rules.remediationGuidance: List CDE audit destinations in governance.RequiredControls; align with azureExtractor diagnostic settings.

rules.title: Daily log review process documented
rules.description: Security logs for CDE systems must reference daily review or automated alerting with human escalation.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document log review cadence in governance.PolicyConstraints and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Time synchronization for CDE audit logs
rules.description: CDE systems must document reliable time sync (NTP) so correlated fraud and incident timelines are trustworthy.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note time-sync expectations in metadata.ChangeDescription for multi-component payment flows.

rules.title: Vulnerability scanning for CDE
rules.description: Internal and external vulnerability scans must be scheduled with remediation SLAs for CDE components.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document scanning cadence in governance.RequiredControls; tag CDE services subject to ASV scans.

rules.title: Penetration testing themes for CDE
rules.description: Annual penetration testing and significant-change retesting must be referenced for CDE and segmentation controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note pentest scope and frequency in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Intrusion detection for CDE network
rules.description: CDE network segments should document IDS/IPS or equivalent cloud-native threat detection with alerting.
rules.remediationGuidance: List detection services in governance.RequiredControls; tag NSG flow logs and Defender for Cloud coverage.

rules.title: Change control for CDE components
rules.description: All changes to CDE systems must trace to documented change approval, testing, and rollback procedures.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe change control in metadata.ChangeDescription and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Security policy and standards documented
rules.description: Payment architecture must reference organizational security policy covering PCI scope, roles, and review cadence.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture policy references in governance.ComplianceTags and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Roles and responsibilities for PCI compliance
rules.description: Named roles (CISO, QSA liaison, network owner) for PCI obligations must be identifiable at system scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record PCI role assignments in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Third-party service provider PCI due diligence
rules.description: Payment processors and SaaS in scope must document PCI compliance status and responsibility matrix.
rules.remediationGuidance: List payment subprocessors on external services[]; tag pci-aoc status in governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Incident response plan for payment breaches
rules.description: Payment incident response must document containment, forensic preservation, and notification timelines.
rules.remediationGuidance: List IR integration for CDE in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Wireless networks excluded or secured in CDE vicinity
rules.description: If wireless exists near CDE, architecture must document segmentation and strong authentication — or exclude wireless from scope.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document wireless posture in governance.PolicyConstraints when applicable to payment retail or IoT paths.

rules.title: Sample data and non-production PAN handling
rules.description: Lower environments must not use live PAN unless documented tokenization or synthetic test data with approval.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag non-prod datastores with pan:prohibited or tokenized in datastores[].Tags and governance.PolicyConstraints.

frameworkMappings.theme: Req 3.2 — No storage of sensitive authentication data
